ezekiel.19.p1.b1.text: “As for you, take up a lament for the princes of Israel

ezekiel.19.p1.b2.text: What was your mother? A lioness among the lions! She lay down among the young lions

ezekiel.19.p1.b3.text: When the nations heard of him, he was trapped in their pit. With hooks they led him away to the land of Egypt.

ezekiel.19.p1.b4.text: With hooks they caged him and brought him to the king of Babylon. … so that his roar was heard no longer on the mountains of Israel.

ezekiel.19.p1.b5.text: Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard, planted by the water; it was fruitful and full of branches

ezekiel.19.p1.b6.text: But it was uprooted in fury, cast down to the ground … on it no strong branch remains fit for a ruler’s scepter.
